challenge.title: A Visit to the Doctor and the Pharmacy
challenge.instructions: Write and act out a conversation of at least 10 lines where you tell a friend or a doctor how you feel, describe at least two symptoms using body-part words, and then go to the pharmacy to get medicine. Use at least 8 target phrases from Unit 9 and include both a masculine-address and a feminine-address form somewhere in your conversation.
required_elements: A question about how someone feels, like كيفك or شو صار فيك.
At least two symptoms named with body-part words, such as راسي or بطني.
A mention of سخونة or وجع راس or another specific complaint.
A question asking since when the person has felt this way, using من أدّيش.
A pharmacy or doctor request using عندك or بدي.
A question about a prescription using وصفة.
Instructions for taking medicine, such as مرتين باليوم.
A closing wish using سلامتك and its reply الله يسلمك.
